diagnostics.message: The GitHub App webhook registration in null_resource.update_app should also wait for the API Gateway stage to be deployed ($default with auto_deploy). The stage has no dependency on the route in the current graph and the null_resource has no dependency on the stage at all, so the local-exec can run against an API endpoint that is not yet serving traffic. An explicit depends_on is needed since the endpoint output references only the API resource.

null_resource.update_app registers the webhook endpoint with the GitHub App via local-exec, but its data dependency (module.multi-runner.webhook.endpoint) only pins aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook. The route that maps POST /webhook to the lambda integration may not exist yet when the provisioner runs, so the registered webhook URL would be non-functional on first apply. The resource should be ordered after the route is created.
